title: Dungeon wall panels: brick, slab and tiled wall blocks in blue, green and pink
player_outcome: Dungeon corridors are lined with Terraria's three dungeon wall styles in the dungeon's colour, instead of one flat brick.
design: New data/blocks/dungeon.json with 9 crisp blocks: {blue,green,pink}_brick_wall, {…}_slab_wall and {…}_tiled_wall. Each has hardness 3.0, pickPower 65, sound stone, tags [dungeon, brick], a map colour, and covers terraria:<id>.
Texture layers in tools/textures/materials.json, type bricks:
{…}_slab: rows 2, cols 1, deep bevel, no stagger.
{…}_tiled: rows 4, cols 4, no stagger, glazed roughness 0.35.
Add stagger/bevel options to tools/textures/gen_built.bricks if missing (synth.bricks already supports stagger).
Rebuild: python3 tools/textures/build_textures.py --set=terrain, then python3 tools/textures/build_icons.py for the derived block items.
Reference rows in tools/content/reference/world_extra.py TILES, kind wall; regenerate data/reference.

Regenerate data/manifest.json with Strata.Tools manifest. The new file shifts runtime block ids, so re-pin the golden hashes in tests/Strata.Core.Tests/WorldGen/WorldGenTests.cs. Output by name is unchanged, so GenVersion is not bumped here; P4-15 bumps it.
verification: lavapipe: 'setblock 2 0 0 blue_slab_wall' etc. and screenshot the three styles
risks: The terrain texture array grows by 9 layers (memory). Check the low preset budget in data/config/graphics.json.
The terrain phase also re-pins hashes. Rebase carefully.
